tools.name: get_meps
tools.description: Get Members of European Parliament with optional filters (country, political group)

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g., 'SE' for Sweden)

group.description: Political group abbreviation (e.g., PPE, S&D, Renew, Greens/EFA)

tools.name: get_plenary_sessions
tools.description: Get European Parliament plenary sessions within a specified date range

eventId.description: Meeting event ID for single meeting lookup

year.description: Filter by calendar year (1900-2100, recommended for annual counts)

tools.name: search_documents
tools.description: Search European Parliament documents by keyword, or retrieve a single document by docId

docId.description: Document ID for single document lookup (bypasses keyword search)

keyword.description: Search keyword or phrase (alphanumeric, spaces, hyphens, underscores)

documentType.description: Document type: REPORT, RESOLUTION, DECISION, DIRECTIVE, REGULATION, OPINION, AMENDMENT

tools.name: get_parliamentary_questions
tools.description: Get parliamentary questions with optional filters for type, author, topic, status, date range, or single lookup by docId

docId.description: Document ID for single question lookup

author.description: MEP identifier or name of question author

topic.description: Question topic or keyword to search

tools.name: get_committee_info
tools.description: Get information about European Parliament committees

showCurrent.description: If true, returns all current active corporate bodies

tools.name: get_voting_records
tools.description: Get voting records from European Parliament sessions

tools.name: monitor_legislative_pipeline
tools.description: Monitor European Parliament legislative pipeline status with bottleneck detection and forecasting

status.description: Pipeline status filter (ALL, ACTIVE, STALLED, COMPLETED)

tools.name: analyze_legislative_effectiveness
tools.description: Analyze legislative effectiveness of an MEP or committee with productivity, quality, and impact scores

subjectId.description: Subject identifier (MEP ID or committee abbreviation)

dateFrom.description: Analysis start date in YYYY-MM-DD format

dateTo.description: Analysis end date in YYYY-MM-DD format

tools.name: get_mep_details
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific MEP including biography, contact information, committee memberships, and parliamentary activities

tools.name: analyze_voting_patterns
tools.description: Analyze voting behavior patterns for a specific MEP, including alignment with political group

dateFrom.description: Analysis start date in YYYY-MM-DD format

compareWithGroup.description: Whether to compare MEP voting with political group average

tools.name: track_legislation
tools.description: Track the progress of a legislative procedure through the European Parliament

tools.name: generate_report
tools.description: Generate an analytical report on European Parliament data (MEP activity, committee performance, voting statistics, or legislation progress)

subjectId.description: Subject identifier (MEP ID, committee ID, etc.) — optional for aggregate reports

dateFrom.description: Report period start date in YYYY-MM-DD format

tools.name: assess_mep_influence
tools.description: Compute MEP influence score using a 5-dimension weighted model: Voting Activity (25%), Legislative Output (25%), Committee Engagement (20%), Parliamentary Oversight (15%), Coalition Building (15%)

dateFrom.description: Analysis start date in YYYY-MM-DD format

dateTo.description: Analysis end date in YYYY-MM-DD format

tools.name: analyze_coalition_dynamics
tools.description: Analyze political group coalition dynamics including cohesion rates, cross-party alliances, defection rates, and stress indicators

groupIds.description: Political group identifiers to analyze (omit for all groups, 1-10 items)

dateFrom.description: Analysis start date in YYYY-MM-DD format

dateTo.description: Analysis end date in YYYY-MM-DD format

minimumCohesion.description: Minimum cohesion threshold for alliance detection (0-1)

tools.name: detect_voting_anomalies
tools.description: Detect unusual voting patterns including party defections, abstention spikes, and low attendance anomalies

dateFrom.description: Analysis start date in YYYY-MM-DD format

tools.name: compare_political_groups
tools.description: Compare political groups across multiple dimensions: voting discipline, activity level, legislative output, attendance, and cohesion

groupIds.description: Political group identifiers to compare (minimum 2, maximum 10)

dateFrom.description: Analysis start date in YYYY-MM-DD format

tools.name: analyze_committee_activity
tools.description: Analyze European Parliament committee workload, meeting frequency, document production, legislative output, and member engagement

tools.name: track_mep_attendance
tools.description: Track and analyze MEP attendance patterns across plenary sessions

tools.name: analyze_country_delegation
tools.description: Analyze a country's MEP delegation — political group distribution, voting behavior, committee presence, and national cohesion

tools.name: generate_political_landscape
tools.description: Generate a comprehensive political landscape overview of the European Parliament — group sizes, seat shares, coalition dynamics

tools.name: get_current_meps
tools.description: Get currently active Members of European Parliament with active mandates

tools.name: get_speeches
tools.description: Get European Parliament plenary speeches and debate contributions

speechId.description: Speech ID for single speech lookup

tools.name: get_procedures
tools.description: Get European Parliament legislative procedures

processId.description: Process ID for single procedure lookup

tools.name: get_adopted_texts
tools.description: Get European Parliament adopted texts including legislative resolutions, positions, and non-legislative resolutions

docId.description: Document ID for single adopted text lookup

tools.name: get_events
tools.description: Get European Parliament events including hearings, conferences, seminars, and institutional events

eventId.description: Event ID for single event lookup

tools.name: get_meeting_activities
tools.description: Get activities linked to a specific EP plenary sitting (debates, votes, presentations)

tools.name: get_meeting_decisions
tools.description: Get decisions made in a specific EP plenary sitting

tools.name: get_mep_declarations
tools.description: Get MEP declarations of financial interests filed under the Rules of Procedure

docId.description: Document ID for single declaration lookup

tools.name: get_incoming_meps
tools.description: Get incoming Members of European Parliament for the current parliamentary term

tools.name: get_outgoing_meps
tools.description: Get outgoing Members of European Parliament for the current parliamentary term

tools.name: get_homonym_meps
tools.description: Get homonym Members of European Parliament (MEPs with identical names)

tools.name: get_plenary_documents
tools.description: Get European Parliament plenary documents

docId.description: Document ID for single document lookup

tools.name: get_committee_documents
tools.description: Get European Parliament committee documents

docId.description: Document ID for single document lookup

tools.name: get_plenary_session_documents
tools.description: Get European Parliament plenary session documents (agendas, minutes, voting lists)

docId.description: Document ID for single document lookup

tools.name: get_plenary_session_document_items
tools.description: Get European Parliament plenary session document items

tools.name: get_controlled_vocabularies
tools.description: Get European Parliament controlled vocabularies (standardized classification terms)

vocId.description: Vocabulary ID for single vocabulary lookup

tools.name: get_external_documents
tools.description: Get external documents (non-EP documents such as Council positions, Commission proposals)

docId.description: Document ID for single document lookup

tools.name: get_meeting_foreseen_activities
tools.description: Get foreseen (planned) activities for a specific EP meeting/plenary sitting

tools.name: get_procedure_events
tools.description: Get events linked to a specific EP legislative procedure (hearings, debates, votes)

tools.name: get_meeting_plenary_session_documents
tools.description: Retrieve plenary session documents linked to a specific EP meeting (plenary sitting)

tools.name: get_meeting_plenary_session_document_items
tools.description: Retrieve plenary session document items linked to a specific EP meeting (plenary sitting)

tools.name: network_analysis
tools.description: MEP relationship network mapping using committee co-membership. Computes centrality scores, cluster assignments, bridging MEPs, and network density metrics

mepId.description: Optional numeric EP API internal MEP ID to focus the network analysis (ego network). Note: Phase 6 OSINT tools use numeric IDs from the EP API v2, unlike core tools which use string identifiers like 'MEP-124810'

tools.name: sentiment_tracker
tools.description: Track political group institutional positioning and inferred sentiment using seat-share distribution as a proxy indicator

groupId.description: Political group ID to track (omit for all groups)

tools.name: early_warning_system
tools.description: Detect emerging political shifts, unusual voting changes, and coalition fracture signals

focusArea.description: Area of political activity to monitor

tools.name: comparative_intelligence
tools.description: Cross-reference MEP activities across committees, delegations, and legislative procedures for comprehensive multi-dimensional profiling

mepIds.description: List of numeric EP API internal MEP IDs to compare (2-10 MEPs). Note: Phase 6 OSINT tools use numeric IDs from the EP API v2, unlike core tools which use string identifiers like 'MEP-124810'

dimensions.description: Dimensions to include in the comparison

tools.name: correlate_intelligence
tools.description: Cross-tool OSINT intelligence correlation engine combining outputs from multiple intelligence tools for consolidated alerts and insights

groups.description: Political groups for coalition fracture analysis (max 8)

tools.name: get_all_generated_stats
tools.description: Retrieve precomputed European Parliament activity statistics (2004-2026) with monthly breakdowns, category rankings, percentile scores, statistical analysis, political landscape history, analytical commentary, and trend-based predictions for 2027-2031

category.description: Activity category to focus on (default: all)

includeRankings.description: Include percentile rankings and statistics (default: true)

tools.name: get_server_health
tools.description: Check server health and feed availability status. Returns server version, uptime, per-feed health status, and overall availability level. Does not make upstream API calls.

tools.name: get_procedure_event_by_id
tools.description: Get a specific event linked to a legislative procedure by process ID and event ID
